newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel long-distance traffic 20 mln mins.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel long-distance traffic 20 mln mins.

text.p: Telephone company Avantel said on Friday it had clocked up more than 20 million minutes of long-distance calls since the market was opened to competition on January 1.
The company said in a statement its network "has now carried more than than 20 million minutes in long distance calls."
Avantel is a joint venture between the Banacci financial group and U.S.-based MCI Communications.
Telefonos de Mexico saw its decades-old monopoly of the Mexican long-distance telephone market end on January 1.
